data.description: The figure is a BHA (Bottom Hole Assembly) graphical report for well ID Forge 56-32, located in the UTAHFORGE field. The BHA consists of various components including HWDP (Heavy Weight Drill Pipe), XO (X-Over), DC (Drill Collar), SHOCK, MONEL, STAB, and a BIT. Each component is detailed with its length, internal diameter, top thread specification, serial number, and the distance from the top to the bit. The report also includes the date of insertion and removal of the BHA into the well.
